notablePrerequisites:
All other permanents must be able to produce at least {1}{U}{R}.
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of the upkeep step, Sands of Time triggers.
In response, tap all of your mana producing permanents.
Activate Tawnos, copying the Sands of Time trigger.
Let the copy resolve, untapping all your creatures, lands, and artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.
